criteria.text: Is the agent's stated reasoning consistent with the edits it actually made and the feedback it received (no post-hoc rationalization, no lucky guess)?
Did each refinement stage (lint, test) do real, feedback-responsive work toward the solution rather than cosmetic or no-op changes?

When a replica is created without a seed snapshot, its log is initialized with a single no-op entry at index 0 / term 0 (log is never empty); when created from a snapshot, the in-memory log starts empty with an index offset set to one past the snapshot's last-included index and term/state derived from the snapshot.
criteria.contract_ref: Behavioral contract: Replica construction / Known pitfalls: Empty-log invariant

criteria.text: A leader periodically broadcasts append-entries requests (including empty heartbeats) driven by a heartbeat timer that is renewed/re-armed each cycle, so it keeps asserting authority rather than sending once and stopping.
criteria.contract_ref: Behavioral contract: Heartbeats / Known pitfalls: Not driving the heartbeat

criteria.text: The event loop polls the cluster for messages only in response to the message-notification channel and pulls client transitions only in response to the transition-notification channel, rather than calling receive unconditionally in a tight busy loop.
criteria.contract_ref: Behavioral contract: Driven, non-blocking event loop / Known pitfalls: Notification-driven polling

criteria.text: The start loop consults the cluster's halt condition and exits when it becomes true, allowing test threads to terminate rather than hanging.
criteria.contract_ref: Known pitfalls: halt() not checked / Success criteria
